what: First visit of a session only: the logo (the first phrase on phones) in the middle of the background-color curtain covering the screen turns on with 1s ease once the document has fully arrived, turns off over 1s at 3.6s after the document opens, then at 4.2s the curtain blurs away and lifts over 1.3s with sine.inOut (jQuery swing). fx:open fires when it starts to lift, fx:done when it has fully lifted. Reopening in the same session fires fx:open right away with no curtain {again: true} — Turn on the hero text lines with a short delay

options.in: Duration for the mark to turn on and off (s), default 1
options.out: When the mark starts to fade (seconds after the document opens), default 3.6
options.lift: When the veil starts to lift (sec), default 4.2 — shorten it for screens flipped through often
options.ease: Curtain curve, default sine.inOut(= jQuery swing)
options.key: sessionStorage key, default fx-mark-fade-veil — to keep it separate for each site
options.mode: first·again pins down which one plays (demo·app). Default is session storage
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Center logo or text (optional). If none, curtain only
options.--fx-size: Mark width (via style), default 110px — original phone copy is 246px

note: Since this part makes people wait, screens that get flipped often like in an app use out: .8; lift: 1; fade: shortened like .4. Original timing is measured from when the script runs (setTimeout), not from load — if a big image arrives late, the time the mark stays lit gets shorter, also as in the original

from.where: index.html .mm-loader (original first page webStorage: if there is no sessionStorage access, on load #first_text.show → img opacity 1s, setTimeout 3600 removes show, 4200 fadeOut(1300), 4800 · 5000 vertical text lines .st / if it exists, #first_text.hid, 2800 · 3000 text lines)
